# Advanced Vision Solutions

> Advanced Vision Solutions is an eye care practice.

- Official website: https://advancedvisionsolutions.com/
- Contact: 915-444-8458 / contact@advancedvisionsolutions.com

## Services

- Neuro-Optometry: Our neuro-optometric team helps patients retrain the brain and eyes to work together so they can get back to living their fullest life.
- Vision Rehab: We specialize in low vision rehabilitation, providing low vision evaluations and equipment for the visually impaired.
- Myopia Control: Our practice offers evidence-based treatment to prevent the onset or reduce the progression of myopia in our young patients.
